title: Vending Machine Denomination Combinations
description: You are managing a smart vending machine that needs to give change. Given different coin denominations available in unlimited quantities and a target amount of money, compute the total number of unique combinations that make up that amount.
constraints: Each coin value is guaranteed to fit in a 32-bit signed integer.
input_format: An integer amount and an array of integers coins representing denominations.
output_format: An integer representing the number of combinations.

examples.explanation: There are four ways to make up the amount: 5=5, 5=2+2+1, 5=2+1+1+1, 5=1+1+1+1+1.
The amount of 3 cannot be made up with just coin 2.
